title: Printed plan lines (F154-FR-009 to F154-FR-011; data-model.md D1)
description: The output of the one renderer `printThePlan`, printed by `specstride doctor` and by `launch --dry-run` as the same bytes (F154-FR-010). PROPOSAL of spec 154. Per phase: the groups, every task made serial with the failed check as its reason, and the ceiling of the speed-up under equal task cost (F154-FR-009). The ceiling is printed with the statement of `expectedSavingStatement` that it is a ceiling and not an expectation (F154-FR-011); nothing here promises a saving (F154-FR-008). Printing takes no slot, writes no record and starts no worker. The lines are the terse form; the serial list is present only behind the verbose flag. Under `parity` nothing is printed. With the option off the plan may be printed, labelled (CQ-154-19 A). The stored plan is `specstride.parallel-plan/1` of feature 142.

planHash.description: The hash of the `specstride.parallel-plan/1` record the lines are rendered from; the same inputs give the same hash and the same bytes (F154-SC-002).

labelled.description: True when the plan is printed with `loop.parallel.units` off, as the plan the option would produce (CQ-154-19 A; F154-FR-009).

verbose.description: True when the serial list is printed (F154-FR-010).

lines.description: The printed lines, in print order, without the line terminator. Terse by default.

phases.description: The plan's phases in phase order, as the lines render them.

groups.description: The groups of the phase in plan order, each with its ordinal and its task ids. May be empty.

serial.description: Every task made serial, with the failed check as its reason. Printed only when verbose.

reason.description: The admission check that failed for the task, a member of the closed set of admission checks of feature 142 (row 61), with its detail where the plan holds one.

ceiling.description: The ceiling of the speed-up under equal task cost. A ceiling, never an expectation (F154-FR-011).

ceilingStatement.description: The text of `expectedSavingStatement`: the numbers are a ceiling under equal task cost and not an expectation (F154-FR-011). The renderer ends with it.
